Esther 4:17: Mordecai went and did everything Esther commanded him,
Isaiah 29:1: Woe, city Ariel, against which David fought! Gather produce year after year, for you will eat with Moab.
Isaiah 29:2: For I will press Ariel hard, and her strength and wealth will be Mine.
Isaiah 29:3: I will surround you like David, set a palisade around you and set towers around you,
Isaiah 29:4: and your words will be humbled into the earth and sink into the earth. Your voice will be like those who speak from the earth, and your voice will weaken toward the ground.
